title: Everyone says IPO lock-in is 90 days. Half of Jio's ₹8,110 Cr just unlocked — TODAY #Shorts
description: Jio Platforms Ltd (NSE: JPL) anchor lock-in Day 30 expiry: 50% of the ₹8,110 Cr anchor allotment (₹4,055 Cr) is now free to sell, as of today, November 25, 2026. India's biggest-ever IPO raised ₹30,188 Cr and was subscribed 21.36×. Anchors allocated on Oct 19, 2026 are sitting on +21.36% gains since listing. The remaining 50% (₹4,055 Cr) stays locked until Jan 24, 2027. Watch JPL's trading volume today for signs of anchor movement.
